mil5.2.2:1.2: Na-tth' Ānanda Tathāgatassa dhammesu ācariyamuṭṭhīti. Puna ca therena Mālunkyāputtena pañhaṃ puṭṭho na byākāsi.
mil5.2.2:1.3: Eso kho bhante Nāgasena pañho dvayanto ekantanissito bhavissati ajānanena vā guyhakaranena vā.
mil5.2.2:1.5: na-tth' Ānanda Tathāgatassa dhammesu ācariyamuṭṭhīti, tena hi therassa Mālunkyāputtassa ajānantena na byākataṃ.
mil5.2.2:1.6: Yadi jānantena na byākataṃ, tena hi atthi Tathāgatassa dhammesu ācariyamuṭṭhi.
mil5.2.2:1.7: Ayam-pi abhatokoṭiko pañho tavānuppatto, so tayā nibbāhitabbo ti.
mil5.2.2:2.1: Bhāsitam-p' etaṃ mahārāja Bhagavatā: Na-tth' Ānanda Tathāgatassa dhammesu ācariyamuṭṭhīti. Abyākato ca therena Mālunkyāputtena pucchito pañho, tañ-ca pana na ajānanena na guyhakaraṇena.
mil5.2.2:2.4: ekaṃsabyākaraṇīyo pañho, vibhajja byākaraṇīyo pañho, paṭipucchābyākaraṇīyo pañho, ṭhapanīyo pañho.
mil5.2.2:3.6: viññāṇaṃ aniccan-ti ekaṃsabyākaraṇīyo pañho; ayaṃ ekaṃsabyākaraṇīyo pañho.
mil5.2.2:4.2: aniccaṃ pana rūpan-ti vibhajja byākaraṇīyo pañho,
mil5.2.2:4.6: aniccaṃ pana viññāṇan-ti vibhajjabyākaraṇīyo pañho; ayaṃ vibhajja byākaraṇīyo pañho.
mil5.2.2:5.2: kin-nu kho cakkhunā sabbaṃ vijānātīti, ayaṃ paṭipucchābyākaraṇīyo pañho.
mil5.2.2:6.6: antavā ca anantavā ca loko ti,
mil5.2.2:6.7: n' ev' antavā nānantavā loko ti,
mil5.2.2:6.12: hoti ca na ca hoti tathāgato param-maraṇā ti,
mil5.2.2:6.13: n' eva hoti na na hoti tathāgato param-maraṇā ti ṭhapanīyo pañho;
mil5.2.2:7.1: Bhagavā mahārāja therassa Mālunkyāputtassa taṃ ṭhapanīyaṃ pañhaṃ na byākāsi.
mil5.2.2:7.3: na tassa dīpanāya hetu vā kāraṇaṃ vā atthi, tasmā so pañho ṭhapanīyo,
mil5.2.2:7.5: Sādhu bhante Nāgasena, evam-etaṃ, tathā sampaṭicchāmīti.
